Senses.Explanation: The phrase places the enormous Mount Sumeru inside a tiny mustard seed. Jiangzhou prefect Li Bo explicitly utters the question in three recensions of his exchange with Guizong Zhichang; those witnesses are one case, not three independent deployments. A separate monastic question in the Patriarchs’ Hall Collection asks the same formula in an independently recorded exchange whose respondent is not identified by this stored cut.
